name: Enhance Ability

header.Components: V, S, M (fur or a feather)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Touch creature; choose STR, DEX, INT, WIS or CHA, excluding CON; Advantage on checks of chosen ability for Concentration; higher slots add recipients with independent ability choices; no obsolete animal-named benefits.

rules.text: You touch a creature and choose Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma.
For the duration, the target has Advantage on ability checks using the chosen ability.
You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.
You can choose a different ability for each target.
